name: Graphile Worker
solves: Provides a high-performance PostgreSQL job queue for Node.js designed for Graphile/PostGraphile stacks, with efficient SKIP LOCKED job claiming, cron, migrations, and the ability to enqueue jobs from SQL triggers.
best_for: PostGraphile/Graphile stacks that want jobs tightly integrated with Postgres
Systems that enqueue work from SQL triggers/functions into a Node worker fleet
High-performance Postgres job processing with careful locking and throughput tuning
Teams already invested in Graphile tooling and migrations
Replace-Redis queue needs when Postgres is the system of record
skip_when: You want a hosted serverless job platform (Inngest/Trigger.dev) with zero PG ops
You need Redis-based features or BullMQ's flow producer ecosystem
Your app is not on PostgreSQL
You prefer pg-boss's simpler API over Graphile Worker conventions
You only need occasional cron in a single Node process

hosted_alternative.name: Inngest
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier for hobby; paid plans scale with executions and concurrency
